# Getting help

| You want to | Go to |
|---|---|
| Learn how something works | [The documentation](https://github.com/rejochandran/issue-jump/wiki) |
| Fix a common problem | [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/rejochandran/issue-jump/wiki/Troubleshooting) |
| Ask a question | [Discussions › Q&A](https://github.com/rejochandran/issue-jump/discussions/new?category=q-a) |
| Suggest a feature or request a tracker | [Discussions › Ideas](https://github.com/rejochandran/issue-jump/discussions/new?category=ideas) |
| Report a bug | [New issue](https://github.com/rejochandran/issue-jump/issues/new/choose) |
| Report a security problem | [Private report](https://github.com/rejochandran/issue-jump/security/advisories/new), never a public issue |

This is a volunteer project. Replies usually come within a week.

When asking for help, include your Issue Jump version (bottom of Settings), your browser, and which tracker is involved. Leave out company names, private issue titles and API keys.
